title: Polydatin improves mitochondrial dynamics dysrhythmia by regulating BMAL1 to prevent and treat metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease.
authors: Wang, Shujun; Wang, Haichao; Yin, Guoliang; Liu, Xuehuan; Xie, Na; Zhang, Xin; Yu, Wenfei; Zhang, Haiyi; Sun, Yuqing; Liu, Hongshuai; Wang, Linya; Qi, Muxi; Feng, Huagui; Zhang, Fengxia
one_liner_zh: 该文研究虎杖苷通过BMAL1调控线粒体动力学改善脂肪肝，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是代谢疾病药理机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上可轻微借鉴。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Polygonum cuspidatum, a traditional Chinese medicine indicated for "blood stasis" and "damp-heat" disorders (e.g., arthralgia, jaundice, amenorrhea), has modern relevance as these conditions correlate with dyslipidemia, inflammation, and microcirculatory issues. Its main constituent, polydatin (PD), exhibits multiple bioactivities, yet its role in metabolic dysfunction-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) remains unclear. AIM OF THE STUDY: To elucidate the mechanisms by which PD alleviates MAFLD through BMAL1-mediated mitochondrial dynamics. MATERIALS AND METHODS: FFA-induced HepG2 cells and HFD-induced MAFLD rats were used to evaluate the effects of PD on hepatic lipid accumulation, mitochondrial function, and oxidative stress immune imbalance via histological staining and biochemical assays. Additionally, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and BMAL1 knockdown experiments were conducted to identify potential upstream regulators. RESULTS: PD significantly suppressed lipid accumulation, reduced levels of ROS, MDA, NLRP3, TNF-alpha, and IL-1beta, while enhancing SOD activity, thereby alleviating oxidative stress-immune imbalance. PD increased mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP), ATP content, and mtDNA copy number, reversing mitochondrial dysfunction. Notably, PD improved expression rhythms of BMAL1 and mitochondrial dynamics-related genes (DRP1, OPA1, MFN1, MFN2, FIS1), normalizing their amplitude and phase. Concurrently, PD activated the mitochondrial autophagy pathway by upregulating PINK1 and PARKIN expression, thereby facilitating timely clearance of impaired mitochondria. Most importantly, all the aforementioned therapeutic benefits of PD were abolished upon BMAL1 knockdown, establishing BMAL1 as an essential target for PD's action. CONCLUSION: This is the first study to demonstrate that PD alleviates MAFLD by mediating BMAL1-regulated circadian rhythms of mitochondrial dynamics, positioning PD as a potential therapeutic candidate for MAFLD.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：虎杖（Polygonum cuspidatum）是一种传统中药，用于治疗“血瘀”和“湿热”证候（如关节痛、黄疸、闭经），这些病症与现代的脂质代谢紊乱、炎症和微循环障碍相关。其主要成分虎杖苷（polydatin, PD）具有多种生物活性，但其在代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MAFLD）中的作用尚不清楚。研究目的：阐明PD通过BMAL1介导的线粒体动力学缓解MAFLD的机制。材料与方法：采用游离脂肪酸（FFA）诱导的HepG2细胞和高脂饮食（HFD）诱导的MAFLD大鼠模型，通过组织学染色和生化检测评估PD对肝脏脂质积累、线粒体功能和氧化应激-免疫失衡的影响。此外，进行了分子对接、分子动力学模拟和BMAL1敲低实验，以识别潜在的上游调控因子。结果：PD显著抑制脂质积累，降低ROS、MDA、NLRP3、TNF-α和IL-1β水平，同时增强SOD活性，从而缓解氧化应激-免疫失衡。PD增加线粒体膜电位（MMP）、ATP含量和mtDNA拷贝数，逆转线粒体功能障碍。值得注意的是，PD改善了BMAL1及线粒体动力学相关基因（DRP1、OPA1、MFN1、MFN2、FIS1）的表达节律，使其振幅和相位正常化。同时，PD通过上调PINK1和PARKIN表达激活线粒体自噬通路，促进受损线粒体的及时清除。最重要的是，BMAL1敲低后，PD的所有上述治疗益处均被消除，表明BMAL1是PD作用的关键靶点。结论：本研究首次证明PD通过介导BMAL1调控的线粒体动力学昼夜节律缓解MAFLD，将PD定位为MAFLD的潜在治疗候选药物。
